messages:
alex: Heads-up — p99 latency jumped in canary after the runtime deploy ~10:32 UTC, spotted by synthetic.
maria: Confirmed. p95 up ~30ms, p99 up ~220ms vs baseline. Started after kernel-affinity tweak landed.
sam: Which flag exactly? I saw the PR but didn't expect a p99 impact.
alex: rwinf-runtime:v2.3.1-kaf (kernel-affinity heuristic change) — canary 10% traffic.
deploy-bot: deploy started for rwinf-runtime:v2.3.1-kaf -> canary (10%)
jing: Dumped a perf sample from a canary replica, attaching snip:
```
# perf summary
- top stacks: kernel_dispatch -> kv_cache_lock_wait -> serve_loop
- latency histogram: p50 28ms p95 92ms p99 318ms
- kv cache eviction rate: 5x baseline
```
maria: kv cache eviction spiked immediately, microbatch sizes observed dropping from 8->2 on short-seq traffic.
sam: Kernel affinity likely packed hot attention kernels onto fewer cores; that increases shared kv-cache pressure -> thrash.
alex: I opened a rollback PR: https://git.internal/repo/pull/1234 (revert kernel-affinity heuristic). Can someone trigger?
sam: Initiating rollback now. Switching canary back to stable.
deploy-bot: rollback started for rwinf-runtime:v2.3.1-kaf -> stable
oncall-bot: incident INC-2026-194200 created (latency regression, canary).
maria: After rollback, canary metrics trending back toward baseline — p99 down to ~88ms after two mins.
jing: Ran a controlled perf matrix locally: varying microbatch size {2,4,8} and kernel-affinity flag on/off. Results: BATCH=4 + affinity=off gives best p99/cost tradeoff for short-seq workloads.
```
make perf-run TARGET=canary BATCH=4
# result: p99 95ms, throughput -4% vs BATCH=8 but p99 improved 40%
```
sam: Action items: 1) revert shipped change (done), 2) add hysteresis to affinity decision so short bursts don't flip affinity, 3) make kv-cache locks finer-grained.
alex: Also suggest a temporary microbatch floor of 4 for routes classified as small-seq until we have better autotune.
maria: I'll open a follow-up ticket with perf data and an AB test plan.
sam: I'll prepare a hotfix with affinity hysteresis + lock refactor for the next deploy window.
jing: Note for postmortem — root cause = misclassifying short-sequence traffic which caused kernel packing and KV cache thrash, amplifying tail latency. Mitigation = rollback + microbatch floor + affinity hysteresis.
alex: Nice work moving fast. Please paste the perf graphs in the ticket.
maria: Will do. Marking incident for 30m stabilization observation.
oncall-bot: incident INC-2026-194200 resolved (post-rollback metrics stable).
sam: Follow-ups scheduled. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
alex: Closing thread once dashboard stable for 30m.
